description: Send and process a real HL7 ADT (Admission, Discharge, Transfer) message through a channel in NextGen Connect. A channel named 'HL7 Message Processor' has been pre-created and deployed, listening on TCP port 6661 for MLLP-framed HL7 messages. Send the sample HL7 ADT^A01 message from /home/ga/sample_adt_message.hl7 through the channel using MLLP protocol (messages must be wrapped with start byte 0x0B and end bytes 0x1C 0x0D). After sending, verify the message was received by checking the channel statistics. You can use the terminal window and tools like curl, nc (netcat), or the REST API at https://localhost:8443/api (credentials: admin/admin, required header: X-Requested-With: OpenAPI). The web dashboard at https://localhost:8443 also shows channel statistics after login.
